ISSUE I- VALIDITY OF THE 2003 REPEAL ACT
10. It is a well-settled principle that the power to repeal a law is coextensive with the power to enact
it. In this context, the KCCA Act was enacted under Entry 42 of the Seventh Schedule of the
Constitution, CA@SLP(Civil) No.27833-27834 of 2011 etc. etc. and it received the assent of the
President of India. The KCCA Act was designed to bring privately operated contract carriages under
